CVE-2023-43804 (CVSS 5.9) is classified as a medium-risk vulnerability discovered in the Python library urllib3. urllib3 serves as an HTTP client library responsible for managing HTTP requests. The vulnerability arose from the exposure of cookie information during redirects, as urllib3 was not originally designed to handle such sensitive data.

urllib3 is a user-friendly HTTP client library for Python. urllib3 doesn't
treat the `Cookie` HTTP header special or provide any helpers for managing
cookies over HTTP, that is the responsibility of the user. However, it is
possible for a user to specify a `Cookie` header and unknowingly leak
information via HTTP redirects to a different origin if that user doesn't
disable redirects explicitly. This issue has been patched in urllib3
